rationale: Established by direct source reading of the installed UE 4.26.2 ImportAssetsCommandlet.cpp: Main returns 0 unconditionally (Result initialised 0 at line 397, only assignment also 0 at line 443), SavePackage's bool is discarded at line 301, ParseImportSettings always returns false (bSuccess never set true), and the entire save block is gated on ImportedAssets.Num() > 0 at line 213-214. Process exit code therefore carries zero information about persistence. This contract makes exit code necessary but never sufficient.
MUST_NOT: Do not treat PROCESS_EXIT == 0 as evidence of a successful import. Never again.

evaluation_order.name: PRE_LAUNCH_INPUT_VALIDATION
evaluation_order.predicate: every source path listed in the import settings exists, is readable, is non-empty, and matches the expected extension
evaluation_order.note: runs BEFORE the commandlet; must never reach UE with a missing input

evaluation_order.name: PROCESS_EXIT
evaluation_order.note: necessary but NOT sufficient; a zero exit with zero persisted packages is the exact run003-shaped trap

evaluation_order.name: SETTINGS_CONSUMED
evaluation_order.predicate: the log contains at least one 'LogAutomatedImport: Importing group' record AND the constructed group count equals the expected group count from the settings file
evaluation_order.note: do NOT use ParseImportSettings' return value; the engine always returns false regardless of outcome

evaluation_order.name: SOURCE_INPUTS_RESOLVED
evaluation_order.predicate: each requested input is accounted for as FOUND or explicitly INVALID, with FOUND count equal to the requested count

evaluation_order.name: PERSISTED_OUTPUT_PRESENT
evaluation_order.predicate: count of newly written or updated .uasset packages in the destination > 0
evaluation_order.note: derived from filesystem evidence with pre/post mtime and size capture, never from exit code

evaluation_order.name: NO_SAVE_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTICS
evaluation_order.predicate: no 'LogSavePackage' failure, no read-only refusal, no source-control add failure, no 'Could not import all groups'

evaluation_order.name: OUTPUT_COVERAGE
evaluation_order.predicate: expected tile/group/object coverage derived from the settings manifest is fully present in the destination; partial coverage is a failure

evaluation_order.name: OUTPUT_VALIDATION
evaluation_order.predicate: an independent validation stage passes (package loadability and, where practical, AssetRegistry visibility)

IMPORT_STAGE_RESULT.INDETERMINATE: evidence unavailable or unreadable, e.g. missing log, unreadable destination, or a stage that cannot be evaluated. Must never be silently upgraded to SUCCESS.

explicit_prohibitions: Never infer success from PROCESS_EXIT alone.
Never infer success from the absence of an error string in the log; the engine suppresses failures by design.
Never use ParseImportSettings' return value as evidence of settings consumption.
Never hardcode an expected package count such as 5711; coverage must be derived from the settings manifest so the gate generalises to arbitrary imports.
wrapper_placement: Immediately after the ImportAssets commandlet returns and BEFORE any MoveAssets or relocation step, while the destination still holds the freshly written packages. Validating after a move would attribute another step's output to this import.

cases.case: exit 0 with all expected packages persisted
log unavailable so consumption is unevaluable
exit 0, packages present, but coverage incomplete

production_mutation: NONE. Contract and tests only; no ImportAssets execution.
